name: okx-demo
purpose: An OKX demo trading account (simulated funds): market data, balances, orders

apiKey.name: OK-ACCESS-KEY
apiKey.help: OKX → Trade → Demo trading → API (create a demo-trading V5 key with Read and Trade); paste the API key, the secret key and the passphrase you set

guide:
OKX V5 REST API at https://www.okx.com/api/v5, on the person's demo trading account (simulated funds): bnbloc adds `x-simulated-trading: 1` to every request, the person's key and passphrase, and signs account and trading requests. Send requests with no key, signature or timestamp.

```sh
# Market data
curl -s 'https://www.okx.com/api/v5/market/ticker?instId=BTC-USDT'
curl -s 'https://www.okx.com/api/v5/market/books?instId=BTC-USDT&sz=5'
# Balances
curl -s 'https://www.okx.com/api/v5/account/balance'
# Open orders, recent fills
curl -s 'https://www.okx.com/api/v5/trade/orders-pending?instType=SPOT'
curl -s 'https://www.okx.com/api/v5/trade/fills?instType=SPOT'
# A limit order, then its cancellation
curl -s -X POST 'https://www.okx.com/api/v5/trade/order' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"instId":"BTC-USDT","tdMode":"cash","side":"buy","ordType":"limit","px":"20000","sz":"0.001"}'
curl -s -X POST 'https://www.okx.com/api/v5/trade/cancel-order' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"instId":"BTC-USDT","ordId":"ORDER_ID"}'
```

Answers are `{"code":"0","data":[…],"msg":""}`; a `code` other than "0" is an error. Placing or cancelling an order asks the person first unless they allowed changes.
